Results.ReviewText:
The "GRILL" is perfect, its right sized for me. For years I had a much larger grill with a side burner......its too much. This grill is perfectly sized and seriously, it has plenty of grill surface.

Drawbacks....the wheels are too small. You cany move it unless one of the sides is up and I fear that will wear out. Other concern is why there is no rear side plate? Looks like it was meant for one but it is wide open?

Bottom Line: This is my FIRST Weber Grill and I will never choose anything else.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill! But.......

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for sharing your honest feedback regarding the Spirit E-325 open back design. We highly recommend keeping the grease tray clean and free of debris and also using a Premium cover to discourage wildlife from getting into the grill. Your comments will be shared with our teams for consideration. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The grill itself is good but I don’t like the open back design because mice, etc. can easily get into the BBQ
Results.Title: Poor design

Results.ReviewText: This piece of equipment has been fabulous. Easy to go from low to wow that’s hot in not time. It’s been fun cooking on it. The only thing I’d suggest could be changed, is I prefer to have my grills on four wheels as opposed to two. Not a complaint, just an opinion.
Results.Title: Pop’s toy

Results.ReviewText: Excellent little grill. I have enjoyed grilling on the E-325 even temperature across the grill and easy to clean up.
Results.Title: Excellent

Results.ReviewText: I think the grill is well made and works well with one disappointment. I found the gap between the top grate is two wide. As I’m flipping my burgers they slide thru the opening and down in the burner area. This happened twice while cooking. I now have to cook with aluminum foil so that they don’t slice down into the burner area.
Results.Title: Lost burgers.

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for sharing your honest feedback regarding the casters and the difficulty moving the grill. Your comments are shared with our team for consideration. We always take customer feedback very serious and use it as an opportunity to improve our products. If you need immediate assistance please reach out to us direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
This grill does a great job of even grilling everything I grill.
Would rate as 5* if it had casters on left side. Keep my grill is on a covered porch and always move it to open area to cook. It's too heavy, too awkward, for many women and seniors needing to  move it everytime they want to use it. No leg - caster replacements were found on line. Built my own! Cut scrap 2x4 to match leg shape, then matched leg length by ripped wide side dimension with 2" ball caster attached.
Results.Title: Spirit® E-325 Gas Grill

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your honest feedback regarding the open back design. So sorry to hear about your experience. Your comments will be shared with our teams for consideration. We would recommend keeping the grill covered with a Premium grill cover and or keeping the grease tray clean to avoid critters from going after the grease in the pan. Hopefully this is helpful. Thank you for giving Weber a try!

Results.ReviewText: Grill functions great. We have owned Webber's in the past and liked them. This new design with no panel on the back is awful. Disappointing that not only is it nor a sleek look but also not practical.  With there no panel it leaves the grease pan open to dogs and racoons.
Results.Title: No back panel

Results.ReviewText: Main slide out angled grease tray needs something to ease cleanup.  Cleanup is time consuming and messy.  The disposable drip tray is fine but the grease drips onto the slide out angled grease tray and is a pain to clean especially since my grill has no wheels and has to be pulled out from the patio wall since access to the angled grease tray is only available from the back side of the grill.
Results.Title: Good grill but messy to clean.

Results.ReviewText: The grill is well made and it works well. Unfortunately, the controls are poorly designed. They are counter intuitive and as a result confusing. You turn the grill on and light it but it’s not a full power till you turn it down low and then to the turbo mode for high heat. Wow, what a terrible design.
Results.Title: Fine grill, lousy control lay out.

Results.ReviewText:
My only knock on the grill is with only two wheels, with the 20-lb propane in tank, the grill was very hard to move around.  I paid to have a pair of wheels installed and now the unit works beautifully.
   It heats up quickly and does everything we want from a grill.
The size is perfect for our family.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-325 Grill

Results.ReviewText: The only issue I have is sometimes not being able to maintain a constant temperature when cooking certain meats.
Results.Title: E-325 Grill Review

Results.ReviewText: The E-325 is a very sturdy and solid grill. The burners do not always ignite with first or even a second turn of the knobs. That is frustrating. The Weber grill cover should also not cost nearly 20% ($89 + tax) of the total cost of the grill itself.
Results.Title: E-325, Solid, but hard to ignite & expensive cover

Results.ReviewText: Great grill - cooks evenly and consistently, sear function works well and is a nice feature.  The only thing I'd prefer is to have stainless steel grates.
Results.Title: Reliable and Consistent

Results.ReviewText: No gauge to tell how much is left in gas tank. Does heat up much higher than my original Weber
Results.Title: No gauge

Results.ReviewText: Very Poor Instructions are included with Grill, don't tell you about different removable cleaning parts or how to adjust the flames
Results.Title: Poor Instructions were Included

Results.ReviewText:
Over all a pretty decent grill.
Grates are small enough and easy to remove for thorough cleaning in a kitchen sink.
One down side is the placement of the drip pan.  The open back allows rain water
to accumulate in the pan causing it to overflow a mixture of grease and water into the base of the unit.
Results.Title: Grill

Results.ReviewText: Just the right size.  Previously had large genesis grill which became too big when children left and we downsized housing.  One problem is that weber doesn't make a cover for this grill with the side tables down.   Also weber does not make full size griddle insert to fit this model.
Results.Title: great grill

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We appreciate your honest feedback, and we are sorry to hear about the scraping on your hand. This is not the Weber experience we strive to provide, and we want to make this right. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText:
When turning on the gas tank the area under grill is much to small. I have scraped the top of my hand more than once. 
We have always owned Weber and this is the first time we have ever had an issue.
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText: I had to get used to the starter not having a push button. Otherwise, I'm very happy with the Weber grill. This is my third Weber. My children have complimented me on the quality of the cooked food from the Weber.
Results.Title: Quality Cooking from the Weber

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We are sorry to hear that the igniters are not working properly. We are here to help. Please look for an outreach email from our Care Team soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: As with previous Weber grills, the igniters are flaky.  After only a few uses, I resorted to manual ignition some times.  Other times, I could ignite the middle burner even if the first burner did not ignite and then the third before coming back to the first.  It would then ignite.  I was also surprised that there was no gauge on the propane tank.  Knowing when to refill is guess work.
Results.Title: Flaky igniters

Results.ReviewText: The grill is excellent but the casing could be better designed.  Issue with the way the tank is held on place/ hard to get to, to turn on/off.  The back is too open.
Results.Title: True Spirit the E-325

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We are sorry to hear that the burners go out on the low and medium heat settings. Our Care Team will reach out to help. Please look for an email outreach from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Will not stay lit unless the burner is on high.    On low or medium with the slightest breeze it will go out.
Results.Title: Not happy

Results.ReviewText: Only complaint is it only has one set of wheels so hard to move ! I did not realize that when I first bought it , otherwise it is great ! Perfect size
Results.Title: Only one set of wheels

Results.ReviewText: Wanted a smaller grill with sides that fold down, so that it takes less room in the garage. This one is perfect. While it does have less cooking space than I have had in the past, we hardly ever used the whole grill area anyway.
Results.Title: The perfect size

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace my fifteen year old Genesis Silver that was still going strong but looking its age.  I couldn’t be happier with this new grill - it performs just as well as the old ‘classic’ and looks great too!
Results.Title: Great Grill at a great price!

Results.ReviewText: Like my last Weber E-210, it cooks evenly and dependably. Hopefully it will last as long as the last one. I only wish the wheels were more maneuverable as I have to move it away from the house when I cook. Also, I'm not always sure if the auto-light feature always works the first time on the left burner. Sometimes I have had to push twice to ensure it's lit.
Results.Title: Weber Spirit E-210

Results.ReviewText: Good little grill, just the right size for my husband and myself. We use the grill a lot and every time it cooks the food perfectly. It took the both of us to put it together but it wasn’t too bad.
Results.Title: Small but mighty

Results.ReviewText: This is our second grill from Weber. A great product and perfect size for my wife and myself. I only wish it came with four wheels to make it easier to move around. As we get older it is sometimes difficult. Overall it is a wonderful grill.
Results.Title: Great Grill
